text:
maria_cs: Heads-up: OpalQuay renewal in ~6w. We're seeing an uptick in tail latency on conversations >1k tokens and the per-conversation cost is trending ~2x our forecast. Want to propose a proactive perf play: small canary that tries int8 quantization + route long-context generation to a compact 13B variant; keep a lightweight model for short UI completions. Thoughts?

alex_se: Sounds good. My quick take: int8 for bulk traffic but keep fp16 for high-sensitivity paths. For routing: if tokens>512 route to compact-13b (kv-cache on). Else route to tiny-6b for short completions.

ben_sre: Data snapshot: last 48h 95p latency for long requests moved from 1.8s -> 3.6s. GPU p95 util spikes around peak. Int8 expected token speedup ~20% on our kernels; enabling prefix KV cache for multi-turn convs should drop repeated token work ~10-15%. Need to account for int8 workspace memory delta.

alex_se: Canary suggestion: create /v1/opal-gen route with two model variants and a token-length based match. Example YAML (canary):
```
routes:
  - name: opal-long-canary
    match: request.tokens > 512
    variants:
      - model: rwd-compact-13b-int8
        weight: 25
      - model: rwd-13b-fp16
        weight: 75
    fallback: rwd-13b-fp16
```
Run for 48-72h, measure latency, cost, and a small eval set for quality drift.

maria_cs: We'll need a customer-facing eval packet. Alex, can you run the top 50 real prompts A/B on both variants and produce a quick pass/fail and a short rubric? I'll schedule an enablement call with their SRE and PM for next Tue.

dina_pm: Note: customer flagged cost concerns last touch. If the canary shows >=15% cost reduction with <=2% drop on our eval pass-rate, we should prepare a renewal upsell that locks in a quantized reserved pool or dedicated compact capacity.

ben_sre: Ops checklist: spin canary pool (2x A100-small with int8 kernels), enable prefix KV cache for sessions with >1 turn, route telemetry tags: token_latency_ms, model_variant, estimated_cost_usd, add canary alert if error_rate >1%.

ben_sre: Quick deploy commands:
```bash
# apply canary routes
rictl routes apply -f opal-long-canary.yml --env prod
# tail logs for the canary
rictl logs tail --service opal-long-canary --since 30m
```

deploy-bot: Started canary opal-long-canary at 2024-08-20T09:12:05Z (instances: 2). :rocket:

maria_cs: I'll send the eval set + a 3-question qual survey to OpalQuay: (1) perceived latency change? (2) any quality regressions? (3) are you open to cost-quality trade for steady savings? We'll capture responses and post here daily.

alex_se: Also add a safety routing rule: if the prompt contains keywords like "policy", "contract", "legal" then force fp16 route. Example match: contains(prompt, "policy") OR contains(prompt, "legal").

maria_cs: Action items: ben - spin canary & enable KV cache (today); alex - run eval + produce routing YAML (today); maria - send eval packet & confirm Tues enablement (tomorrow); dina - draft renewal messaging contingent on canary results. I'll update daily in this thread. :white_check_mark:

ben_sre: On it. Will post snapshot once we hit 1k canary calls.

alex_se: I'll also tag logs with per-variant $/1k tokens so we can show a clear cost delta in the renewal deck.

maria_cs: Thanks team — aim for initial metrics by EOD tomorrow.
